DISCOVERY 612, PRESENT: ROBERT H. PETERSON, III, ESQ. FOR DEFENDANT/MOVING PARTY. TENTATIVE RULING ADOPTED. DEFENDANTS' MOTION TO COMPEL ATTENDANCE AT DEPOSITION AND PRODUCTION OF DOCUMENTS IS GRANTED AS HE SEEKS TO COMPEL PLAINTIFF TO APPEAR FOR DEPOSITION AS PLAINTIFF AGREES TO APPEAR. THE PARTIES ARE ORDERED TO MEET AND CONFER AND TO AGREE UPON ONE OF THE DATES OFFERED IN THE OPPOSITION. THE DISCOVERY CUTOFF IS EXTENDED TO ALLOW FOR THE COMPLETION OF THE DEPOSITION. PURSUANT TO THE REQUEST FOR DOCUMENTS AT THE DEPOSITION, PLAINTIFF SHALL PRODUCE THE ORIGINALS OR COPIES OF THE DOCUMENTS REQUESTED. THE MOTION IS DENIED AS IT SEEKS MONETARY SANCTIONS AND CONTEMPT OF COURT. ORDER SIGNED IN OPEN COURT. COMM: EVERETT A. HEWLETT
